searchText: Besu defaults to discv4+discv5 from its next version. Current version `v26.9.0` has a switch for it, but defaults to discv4. <https://github.com/besu-eth/besu/pull/11344> Erigon defaults to discv5, a switch to enable discv4 exists Ethrex defaults to discv4+discv5 Geth defaults to discv4+discv5 Nethermind defaults to discv4+discv5 Nimbus EL/Unified defaults to discv5, there is no `--discv4` switch. The wording of the `--discv5` switch suggests that it is the only implemented protocol: "When disabled, peers must be added manually" Reth defaults to discv4+discv5 That's from `--help` texts; definitely worth confirming on ACDT

excerpts.content: Besu defaults to discv4+discv5 from its next version. Current version `v26.9.0` has a switch for it, but defaults to discv4. <https://github.com/besu-eth/besu/pull/11344>

excerpts.author: yorickdowne
excerpts.content:
Erigon defaults to discv5, a switch to enable discv4 exists
Ethrex defaults to discv4+discv5
Geth defaults to discv4+discv5
Nethermind defaults to discv4+discv5
Nimbus EL/Unified defaults to discv5, there is no `--discv4` switch. The wording of the `--discv5` switch suggests that it is the only implemented protocol: "When disabled, peers must be added manually"
Reth defaults to discv4+discv5
